prizes.payment_options: USD, USDCa, or other comparable value at Administrator discretion

criteria.name: Volume
criteria.quote: Total USDC processed through the endpoint during competition. Both total payment volume and real measurable activity.

criteria.name: Use Case Quality
criteria.quote: x402 must be meaningfully integrated into the core payment flow (not bolted on). Clear value in pay-per-request, agentic payments, API monetization, data access, or digital services.

criteria.name: Sustained Potential
criteria.quote: Could the endpoint remain active and generate usage post-competition? Credible path to long-term adoption/viability.

criteria.name: Innovation
criteria.quote: Novel, thoughtful, or technically meaningful use of x402. New payment flows, agentic commerce patterns, infrastructure patterns, or practical implementations that expand x402.

how_to_win: Ship a paid x402 endpoint on Algorand Mainnet
Generate real on-chain usage volume via GoPlausible facilitator
Enable Bazaar discovery so your endpoint is findable
Drive sustained traffic through the unannounced October measurement window
Top 50 on leaderboard → considered for 10 finalist spots
10 finalists present live at Devcon 8, India (Nov 2)
judging.leaderboard_formula: Real on-chain USDC volume settled through GoPlausible facilitator, measured over unannounced window in October 2026
judging.anti_fraud: Administrator reviews for artificial volume, wash transactions, self-payments. Inauthentic activity may be excluded or adjusted.

checklist: Build and test x402 endpoint on Algorand TestNet
Deploy to Algorand MainNet with public HTTPS endpoint
Add x402-global-challenge tag in resource server config
Complete at least one real MainNet payment and confirm USDC received (ASA 31566704)
Ensure endpoint appears in Bazaar and on leaderboard
Drive real usage through early October (unannounced measurement window)
Submit project details via submission form (opens Sept 2, sent via email)
submission.submission_form: Sent via email to registered entrants after Sept 2

tracks.name: Standard
tracks.description: One project, one endpoint, one price. Single paid capability.

tracks.name: Composite
tracks.description: Multiple endpoints sharing the same payTo address. Volume auto-rolls-up on leaderboard.

tracks.name: Orchestrator
tracks.description: Product calls other teams' endpoints. Your incoming payments count for you; outgoing payments count for both you AND the receiving endpoint.

eligibility.sanctions: Cannot be under US/UN/EU sanctions or on OFAC lists
eligibility.team_size: Each participant may only be on one team; each team may submit one project
eligibility.ip: Entrants retain all IP in their submissions
eligibility.notes: No explicit US-person exclusion. Identity documents required to prove eligibility.

strategy_notes.our_endpoint: Domain verification, domain scoring, LLM pricing — multiple endpoints, same payTo
strategy_notes.overlap_with_finalbuilds2: high — factory deploys endpoints, volume flywheel, leaderboard aggregation
strategy_notes.overlap_with_telegraph: medium — both involve paid API endpoints, but different protocol
strategy_notes.key_insight: Composite entry: multiple independent endpoints sharing one payTo. Leaderboard auto-aggregates volume. More endpoints = more surface area = more traffic. finalbuilds2 is the engine that decides WHAT to deploy.
strategy_notes.build_priority: Deploy domain.verify as first x402 endpoint on Algorand MainNet before Sept 2 submission form opens
strategy_notes.platform_play: finalbuilds2 factory monitors what gets traffic, deploys more winners. 402Arena evidence market proves calls are real. Anti-cheat proves volume isn't faked.
